metadata.scenario_context: Jeff, Anne, and Sarah are colleagues at a tech startup and have decided to cook together to celebrate some recent achievements they have made within the company. They intend to discuss the recent news reports about AI advancements that could potentially benefit their business.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Venezuela have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Choosing and discussing the menu for their cooking session.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Jeff, have you thought about what kind of dessert we should make? I was thinking something salted... maybe salted caramel? 

Also, with all the recent news about AI, do you think people still have confidence in the press? It seems like trust is really shaky these days.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message:
Salted caramel sounds good, but how about we consider something traditional, like flan? It’s delicious and reminds me of home. 

As for the press... honestly, I don’t think people trust them at all. In Venezuela, it’s hard to find reliable information. I don't see that changing anytime soon.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
Flan is definitely a great option, but salted caramel has that unique twist. We could even combine them somehow... 

But I really think a lot of people in Canada still have a great deal of confidence in the press. I mean, even with all the noise and controversies, the media plays an important role, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message:
Combining them could be interesting... but flan is a classic that speaks to our roots. 

About the press, I just can't agree. In Venezuela, they twist the truth, and I see that skepticism everywhere. Even if some in Canada trust it, I wouldn’t take their word for it. The press is often unreliable, and that’s something I can’t shake off.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
I totally get that flan is a classic and carries a lot of meaning! But the combinations we create can be a beautiful way to celebrate our different backgrounds too. 

And you know, when you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us. Sure, there are different experiences with the press around the world, but deep down, we are all the same. People are pretty much motivated by the same things, wanting reliable information and truth. We all just want to communicate and connect, right?
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Jeff
